items.position: Technical Lead & Solutions Architect | Software Application Developer
highlights: Cloud & Full-Stack Architecture: Leadership in the design and development of cloud-native systems using .NET 8, Blazor WebAssembly, Azure Service Bus and Worker Services. Comprehensive Azure infrastructure management (App Service, SQL, VPN Gateway, Entra ID) ensuring high availability, security and cost optimization.

Data Engineering & Analytics: Design and implementation of data ecosystems under Medallion architecture (Bronze–Silver–Gold) on SQL Server. Orchestration of 148+ SSIS packages to transform 70+ sales tables in enterprise Data Lake projects, drastically reducing analytical cycle times for BI teams.

Business Intelligence: End-to-end delivery of BI platforms with Power BI, Python (Streamlit), advanced DAX modeling, DirectQuery and star schema. Solutions deployed for government ministries, banking institutions and retail/logistics companies.

System Modernization: Full migration of legacy on-premise applications to cloud-native architectures on Azure, eliminating obsolete dependencies and enabling multi-device access with guaranteed operational continuity.

Strategic Consulting & Bids: Development of SOWs, technical roadmaps, infrastructure sizing and risk classification by support tier for projects in regulated sectors: banking, government, aviation and telecommunications.
Technical Leadership & Scrum: Direction of agile development squads, executive stakeholder management and strategic alignment between business units and IT teams on high-impact projects.

Full-Stack Development & SaaS Architecture: Design and delivery of comprehensive web solutions for international clients — e-commerce platforms, landing pages and ERP systems. Modern stack: React, Next.js, Angular, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS on frontend; Node.js, Express, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Supabase and Firebase on backend.

MiBoletoni (PaaS/SaaS): End-to-end architecture and Google Cloud deployment of a digital ticketing platform. Integration of payment gateways (Stripe/Fygaro), offline-first QR code access validation, multi-role financial administration panels and secure authentication management.

DevOps, CI/CD & Security: Software lifecycle automation with GitHub Actions targeting Vercel and Google Cloud (Cloud Run, Cloud Build). Docker containerization, SSISDB deployment maintenance and resolution of critical vulnerabilities in Firebase Cloud Storage.

Data Science & Analytics: Advanced analysis with Python (Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn) and Power BI to transform data into strategic insights supporting complex decision-making for clients in sales, finance and operations.

Business Analysis & Process Improvement: Strategic evaluation and implementation of technology solutions aimed at optimizing financial performance. Identification of bottlenecks and design of data-driven workflows to strengthen operational infrastructure.

Data Visualization & BI: Design and implementation of interactive dashboards with critical KPIs in Power BI, enabling measurement of effectiveness and ROI of implemented solutions for strategic decision-making.

Marketing Tech & Digital Analytics: Web development management with CMS (WordPress, Wix Studio). Execution of Technical SEO strategies and full analytics stack integration: Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager and Meta Pixel for precise event and conversion tracking.

Digital Transformation & Oracle APEX: Technical leadership in the development and deployment of enterprise applications with Oracle SQL and Oracle APEX, successfully automating critical operational processes for the Digital Transformation division of one of Central America's leading telecom operators.

SDLC Management & Quality Control: Full software development lifecycle control — architecture diagram design, standardized technical documentation in Confluence and exhaustive supervision of SIT, UAT and QA testing phases to ensure product viability and quality.

Agile & Strategic Alignment: Coordination of cross-functional teams under Scrum and Kanban with Jira. Key technical liaison between business units and IT teams, efficiently translating complex requirements into clear, measurable deliverables.
Core Development & Evolutionary Maintenance: Development and maintenance of information systems for the insurance sector using PL/SQL, Oracle Forms and Oracle Reports.
Transactional Data Management: Administration of large volumes of transactional data ensuring integrity, security and business logic compliance through advanced queries and process optimization.
Insurance policy subscription management and analysis. Operation of specialized underwriting systems and personnel training on GPS technology applied to agricultural policies.
Preventive and corrective hardware maintenance, CCTV system administration and on-site/remote technical support to ensure operational continuity in retail environments.

projects.title: MiBoletoni — Digital Ticketing Platform
projects.description: Complete PaaS platform for digital ticket management and sales. I designed a scalable architecture that handles real-time traffic spikes. Features dynamic QR code generation, ticket printing for physical point-of-sale, Auth and user roles, payment gateway integration (Fygaro) and a financial administration panel.

projects.title: Movie Vault & Movie Manager
projects.description: Full-stack application with decoupled frontend/backend architecture for personal movie collection management. Backend built with Node.js + Express deployed on Render, with a RESTful API secured by Firebase Auth and a role-based access system (Admin: full CRUD / Viewer: read-only). TMDB API integration for real-time movie search, posters, synopsis, director, cast and ratings. Data persistence on MongoDB Atlas. React 19 frontend with Netflix-style dark design, advanced filters, multi-criteria sorting, personal star ratings, private notes per movie and skeleton animations. Independent deployment: frontend on Vercel, backend on Render.

projects.title: MEF Panama — Budget BI Platform
projects.description: End-to-end Business Intelligence platform for the management and analysis of budget execution across Panama's public sector. Integrates a relational data model in SQL Server under Star Schema architecture, advanced DAX metrics with year-over-year (YoY) variance, DirectQuery and SQL views optimized for Power BI. Includes an HTML landing page with a simulated role-based access system (Analyst, Director, Minister), budget execution traffic light indicator and coverage of 10 ministries across 3 fiscal years (2022–2024).

projects.title: Panel Finanza Inteligente
projects.description: Professional financial dashboard with real-time Google Sheets integration as a dynamic backend. Built with Next.js 15, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, it features auto-sync every 5 seconds, interactive historical trend charts (Recharts), expense distribution by category, transaction table with advanced search and filtering, and a quick-add modal with direct write to Google Sheets. Premium UI with glassmorphism design, vibrant gradients and smooth animations powered by Framer Motion. Global state management with Zustand and Next.js 15 App Router architecture.

projects.title: Properties & Analytics
projects.description: Progressive Web App (PWA) for the real estate sector. Enables agents to manage inventory and users to filter properties using advanced search algorithms. Integrated interactive maps and a price-per-square-meter analytics module.

projects.title: TechServices & IT Solutions
projects.description: High-performance corporate website for a technology services agency. I designed a conversion-focused and speed-optimized user experience (UX). Implemented advanced Semantic SEO and image optimization practices, achieving load times under 1.5s. The modular architecture enables scaling new service sections without technical debt.

projects.title: City Pizzeria
projects.description: Single Page Application (SPA) e-commerce. I designed a native centralized state architecture with React 19, optimizing data flow without relying on external libraries. The system integrates a real-time cart engine, dynamic GST tax calculation and a 3-stage checkout pipeline with strict validation via controlled forms. Fully responsive interface built with React Bootstrap.

projects.title: EmprenFactor — Entrepreneurship Blog
projects.description: Full-stack content platform aimed at Spanish-speaking entrepreneurs. Built with React + Vite, it features a real-time article search engine, dynamic filtering by categories (Finance, Productivity, Digital Marketing, Business Ideas), featured posts section, validated contact form and responsive navigation. Backend powered by Firebase (Firestore + custom security rules). Integrated with Google Search Console for SEO traceability and deployed in production via Vercel.

items.title: Data Engineering & Medallion Architecture
items.intro: I turn scattered data into reliable assets. I design end-to-end data pipelines and architectures, from raw ingestion to the analytics layer, with quality, traceability and performance as baseline requirements.

bullets.label: ETL/ELT Pipelines & Medallion Architecture:
bullets.text: Data Lakes following the Bronze–Silver–Gold model with SQL Server, SSIS and Python. Orchestration of 148+ ETL packages in an enterprise project, including SSISDB deployments and production package maintenance.

bullets.label: Data Warehouse, Data Mart & Modeling:
bullets.text: Dimensional modeling (star schema), Data Warehouses and Data Marts on SQL Server, PostgreSQL and Oracle, built for fast analytical queries and traceability across layers.

bullets.label: Cloud Data Ecosystem:
bullets.text: Hands-on with the Azure and Databricks data ecosystem, plus Medallion architecture proposals on Microsoft Fabric. Continuous training in SQL, Snowflake and MongoDB to pick the right tool for each case.

bullets.label: Master's in Big Data & Data Engineering (in progress):
bullets.text: Postgraduate continuing-education master's at UCM (Complutense University of Madrid), 2026–27: Apache Spark for data pipelines, Apache Kafka and real-time processing, Data Lakehouses, Cloud Data Engineering on Azure and MLOps.

items.title: Database Administration (DBA) & Performance
items.intro: I keep databases available, secure and fast. I administer relational engines in enterprise environments and optimize queries and processes so they perform well under real load.

bullets.label: Oracle on ODA:
bullets.text: Administration of Oracle 19c databases on Oracle Database Appliance, with RAC, Data Guard and ASM. Query and process optimization in an enterprise project.

bullets.label: PostgreSQL & SQL Server:
bullets.text: Administration, schema design, indexing and query tuning on PostgreSQL and SQL Server, finding and resolving bottlenecks.

bullets.label: Availability & Documentation:
bullets.text: High availability and disaster recovery with Data Guard. Technical documentation of environments and support for development teams on efficient database usage.

items.title: Business Intelligence, Analytics & Predictive Models
items.intro: I take data to the people who make decisions. I build executive dashboards and analytical models that answer business questions with clear KPIs and traceable data.

bullets.label: Executive Dashboards & Power BI:
bullets.text: Interactive dashboards with DAX modeling, DirectQuery and star schema, built around business KPIs. BI platforms delivered to organizations across different industries.

bullets.label: Python for Analysis & Machine Learning:
bullets.text: Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn and Statsmodels for predictive analysis, financial forecasting and customer segmentation.

bullets.label: Data Applications:
bullets.text: Data web apps with Streamlit and Plotly as decision-support tools for executive teams.

items.title: Full-Stack Engineering & Web Architecture
items.intro: I design and build high-performance digital platforms, from modern SPAs to complex enterprise architectures. Every solution follows Clean Architecture principles, built to scale, stay maintainable and deliver value from the first deploy.

bullets.label: Frontend & High-Fidelity UI:
bullets.text: Interfaces with HTML, CSS, React, Next.js, Angular and TypeScript on Tailwind CSS, Shadcn and Bootstrap. State management with TanStack Query and Zustand. Applications that combine speed, accessibility and a good user experience.

bullets.label: Enterprise Backend:
bullets.text: Robust, scalable APIs with .NET 8 (C#/ASP.NET Core), Spring Boot, Node.js and Express, applying Singleton, Repository and Factory patterns. Integration with Azure Service Bus and Worker Services for event-driven solutions in critical transactions.

bullets.label: Deployment, Performance & Technical SEO:
bullets.text: Deployments on Cloudflare, Vercel and Azure App Service with DNS, SSL/HTTPS and security audits. Core Web Vitals optimization and analytics with GA4, Search Console and Tag Manager. API testing with Postman and SoapUI.

items.title: Cloud, DevOps & Infrastructure as Code
items.intro: I design resilient cloud architectures, on Azure, AWS or GCP depending on what each project needs, and remove the friction between code and production: automated pipelines, containers and reproducible infrastructure.

bullets.label: Cloud Architecture:
bullets.text: Multi-tier architectures on Azure (App Service, SQL, Service Bus, VPN Gateway, Entra ID), AWS (EC2, S3, RDS) and GCP (Cloud Run). Event-driven and serverless patterns for high-demand, high-availability environments.

bullets.label: Migration, Modernization & Sizing:
bullets.text: Migration of legacy on-premise systems to cloud-native architectures, architecture proposals, infrastructure sizing and risk classification by support tier for tenders and stakeholders.

bullets.label: CI/CD, Containers & IaC:
bullets.text: GitHub Actions, Cloud Build, Docker/Compose, Terraform and Linux servers with Nginx. Git/Gitflow workflows in distributed teams, with secrets management and vulnerability reviews.

items.title: Applied AI & Agents

bullets.label: LLMs, RAG & Data Extraction:
bullets.text: Applications with Claude, Gemini and OpenAI: structured prompting, output control, RAG and data extraction from images and PDFs with OCR on PostgreSQL and pgvector.

bullets.label: MCP, Agents & Skills:
